mapper.update: UPDATE hypervisor_host SET availability_zone = #{capacity.availabilityZone}, vcpus = #{capacity.totalVcpus}, ram = #{capacity.totalMemoryGb}, disk = #{capacity.totalDiskGb}, gpus = #{capacity.gpus}, used_vcpus = #{usage.vcpus}, used_ram = #{usage.memoryGb}, used_disk = #{usage.diskGb}, used_gpus = #{usage.gpus}, reserved_vcpu = 0, reserved_memory_gb = 0, reserved_disk_gb = 0, reserved_gpu = 0, running_vms = 0, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, resource_version = #{version}

UPDATE hypervisor_host SET reserved_vcpu = reserved_vcpu + #{resources.vcpus} * #{reservationMultiplier}, used_vcpus = used_vcpus + #{resources.vcpus} * #{usedMultiplier}, reserved_memory_gb = reserved_memory_gb + #{resources.memoryGb} * #{reservationMultiplier}, used_ram = used_ram + #{resources.memoryGb} * #{usedMultiplier}, reserved_disk_gb = reserved_disk_gb + #{resources.diskGb} * #{reservationMultiplier}, used_disk = used_disk + #{resources.diskGb} * #{usedMultiplier}, reserved_gpu = reserved_gpu + #{resources.gpuRequest} * #{reservationMultiplier}, used_gpus = used_gpus + #{resources.gpuRequest} * #{usedMultiplier}, running_vms = running_vms + #{usedMultiplier}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, resource_version = #{version}

UPDATE hypervisor_host SET hypervisor_status = #{status}, expected_maintenance_time = COALESCE(#{expectedMaintenanceTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, expected_maintenance_time), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, resource_version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT resource_version FROM hypervisor_host WHERE id = #{hypervisorId}
